title: I deliver food at night. Every Thursday the same address orders two meals. The house has been empty for years.
transcript:
I deliver food at night. Every Thursday the same address orders two meals. The house has been empty for years. The address is 41 Larch Street. The app says the order is for two, one pasta, one soup, paid in advance, with a tip that is always exactly ten dollars.

The first Thursday I assumed it was a mistake. The windows were dark and a realtor sign leaned in the yard, faded white. I left the bag on the porch and drove away.

The next Thursday the bag was gone. The porch light was on. I told myself someone had picked it up.

The third Thursday I waited in my car. At 11:15 the front door opened by itself. Nobody stepped out. The bag lifted off the porch, slowly, like someone was carrying it carefully, and the door closed.

I should have quit then. Instead I checked the order. A note field I had never read said, Please knock twice. We are shy.

Last night the order came again, but the soup was missing. It said, one pasta, and a third line I had not seen before.

Delivery for the driver. Please come inside, we kept you a seat.

I am parked outside right now.

The porch light just turned off.
